[[File:Flying_hotels.jpg|thumb|Flying hotels drifting over Alderaan's surface]]
{{Quote|Huge flying hotels drifted aimlessly across the continents with no destination in mind, just a place to get away from personal pressures.|[[Hari Seldona]]|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
'''Alderaanian flying hotels''' were huge atmospheric airships that were used as nomadic [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] before [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|its destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
Flying hotels were equipped with inflatable air bladders and translucent sheets of flexible film. They would fly at random over the grassy surface of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], without a destination or a schedule. These transports were designed for strained tourists, who could stare out across the untouched landscape of Alderaan and forget their responsibilities for a time.
